notes.5: nr̄i = nostri (bar over r-i). inatriis: no word space between in and atriis (3 minims, then a). ierlm̄ written twice, the second after the painted [I].

notes.13: adpacem: no word space between ad and pacem. habūdā: bars over u and over the final a.
notes.16: inturribus: in and turribus are written without a word space (6 px gap, the t's crossbar runs into the u). fr̄es = fratres.
notes.17: ꝓximos: the p has a long looped stroke curling left below the line (pro).
notes.18: domū: the d and o bite (d's right side is o's left side), then m and ū.
notes.19: G = Gloria (ink capital with a yellow wash). The final ps (psalm cue?) is in slightly paler brown ink, not red; the p has a long top stroke and a hairline across its descender.
notes.21: mīa: the bar over i-a touches the descender of the q above. Final e has a hairline hook rising from it (eius abbreviation or a line-end flourish), written e͛.

p2/pg-038.notes: Office of the Dead, Vespers: Ps 145 (Lauda anima mea) vv. 4-10, Requiem, versicle A porta inferi, prayer. Ink is paler than on other pages. L1: er-hooks above u (reu͛tetur) and t (t͛ram). L3: after B- 'eat' + a full-size us-sign (two strokes joined at top, tail down-left); 'cuius' is c + the same sign with a thick dot at its foot: read cꝰ (could be cu + reduced sign). L7: four minims between o and a (m + barred i). L8: ſcl̄m with a hairline through the l ascender; after fac a small raised cross-shaped t. L9: ink has 'in iniuriam'. L10: raised us-hook after b of esurientib, partly under the initial frame; after painted [D] only a round s is visible (no n). L11: do + full-size 9-shaped us-sign; illuīat = ill + u + barred i + a + t. L14: auenas (no d). L16: p and e share a stroke in diſperdet. L18: [R] = red versicle sign; A is the scribe's capital touched with yellow. L19: [R] = red response sign; E touched with yellow; a stray dot in the right margin ignored. L20: u after the painted S touched with yellow; 'q. d.' with mid-height points; final ꝓ with looped descender.

notes.1: 'ꝓ̄o' (proprio?): p-form with a looped tail through the foot (as ꝓ in f.12r 'ꝓpter') + o, with a hooked abbreviation flag above the o; 'ſangū': after g only two strokes, flag above the last (sanguine). Letters on the line are ꝓ,o and ſ,a,n,g,u.
notes.2: 'pu' at line end: only three strokes after 'do' (p stem, bowl stroke, one stroke); the u's first stroke seems to share the p's bowl stroke.
notes.3: Last letter of 'iudic̄' (c or e-like with flag) with an oblique stroke above it; read as abbreviated iudicii.
notes.5: 'pꝛ̄i' = p + 2-shaped r + i under a long bar (patri-arche); the 2-shaped letter could conceivably be a damaged a.
notes.7: Bars through/over the l of kyriel. and over p of xp̄el.; the 'r' of the first kyriel is ꝛ, of the second straight r. The brown hairline after 'ne' is read as the e's tail (no point); the red dot after it is [R]. P and E have yellow wash (ink capitals, not painted initials).
notes.16: 'ꝓpi': four strokes: ꝓ (stem+bowl, loop below) whose bowl stroke is shared with the following p, then i. Line 17 begins 'ci' (c: flat top bar, no ascender poke) = propiciaberis.
notes.18: 'atiis': after t only two strokes (accented ii) then s; no separate r visible (a blob above t may be a descender from the line above or a raised r).
notes.21: Mark above the o of 'no' (small raised s-like curl) taken as raised s; flourish at the line end ignored.

notes.8: 'ꝫ' here is the free-standing z-shaped et-sign (Tironian et) with a long hairline; also l.15.
notes.14: After painted [S]: ink capital P with bar + round s (= Spiritus). 'paclitus': p a c l i t u s with no visible sign for -ra- (paraclitus).
notes.15: 'rege͛': diamond mark above the final e (regere). 'illuīare': after ill only u + one stroke under a bar, then are (illuminare). Final 'c̄': c with a mark above (cum); a faint flourish after it ignored.
notes.16: 'ōs': o + round s under a bar (omnes).
notes.17: 'auxllare': x followed directly by two tall l's; no i visible (auxiliare).
notes.19: 'mēte': only ~4 elements under the bar (m squeezed, t/e bitten); 'ſc̄e', 'ſpūs' abbreviations.
notes.20: Last word: v (same form as the v of viſites, not d) + three minims (hairline joins at the feet) + a; read 'vuia'; text unclear (divina expected?).
notes.21: 'nus' at line start = 4 minims + s (continuation of line 20's last word?).

notes.1: 'hōim': h with ascender loop fused to o, bar over o/i, then 4 strokes (i + m with final tail); point after.
notes.3: 'apꝛehenderunt' with single p (no sign for a second p or com-). 'Fuit': ink capital F written as a long ſ-like stroke + crossed f (ff-form); written as one capital F. 'hō' = homo.
notes.4: 'adeo' (a deo) without a visible word space. Last word: i o h (long limb descending) + a short descending letter under a bar, read 'iohs̄' (Iohannes); the last letter could also be read as ꝛ.
notes.5: 'inteſtimoniuꝫ': no space between 'in' and 'te'. H (ink capital with yellow wash).
notes.7: 'om̄s': o + 3 strokes (m) under a bar + round s.
notes.12: I of 'In' is an ink capital with yellow wash. 'ꝑ' = p with stroke across the descender.
notes.14: 'ꝓpꝛia': first p with a looped descender (pro) sharing a base stroke with the following plain p, then r rotunda, i, a.
notes.17: 'hijs': h (long limb), i, descending j, round s.
notes.18: Last: ink capital Q (yellow wash) + a small raised hook after it, taken as superscript i (Qui).
notes.19: 'ſanguībus': after g only three strokes (u + i) under a bar, then bus.
